# Labels

| Label | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `bug` | Something does not work as documented |
| `enhancement` | A new capability or an improvement |
| `plugin` | A provider, model, enricher or vector store |
| `docs` | Documentation only |
| `security` | Hardening or a vulnerability (report real vulnerabilities privately: see SECURITY.md) |
| `good first issue` | Small, well-scoped, a good place to start |
| `help wanted` | Open for anyone to take; say so on the issue |
| `prompt` | Relates to a numbered build prompt in `docs/prompts/` |
